name: Ansel
title: Charter drover
examine: Roped at the ankle to a cage he is not in, because a man let out to sit is a better sign than a man in a box.
lines: They let me out to sit. There is nowhere to sit to.
I had the Charter's chit and he wanted paper. A chit is paper. He said it was not the right paper.
He says the order left the waystation to burn and he has the glass to prove it. He says it every morning. I have stopped hearing it.
